title: Sport's longest winning streak has a sad story
description:
Jahangir Khan of Pakistan won 555 consecutive squash matches between 1981 and 1986 - the longest winning streak in professional sport, per Guinness. He built it as a tribute to his brother.
The next-longest streak in any sport is Esther Vergeer's 470 - her story is on this channel.
